chars.ADAM: ADAM: a very tall, extremely skinny young man (stick-thin arms and legs) wearing an oversized pale blue short-sleeve shirt hanging loose on him, beige chino trousers and white sneakers.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white top, wide light-blue jeans and a dark brown long hair scarf-free ponytail style shown as a small brown bun on her round white head.
chars.BIG: BIG: a huge muscular bodybuilder young man with giant arms and a wide chest, wearing a tight black sleeveless tank top, grey jogger pants and a thin silver chain.
chars.FRIENDS: FRIENDS: two young men, one in a red hoodie and one in a green bomber jacket, both in dark jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening house party in a modern Casablanca apartment living room with fairy lights, other guests blurred far in the background. GIRL smiles and talks to ADAM, ADAM stands stiffly, surprised and shy, hands behind his back. Both standing face to face in the centre. Wide shot from further away: the characters are drawn SMALLER, their heads well below the upper third of the picture (heads around 40% from the top), lots of ceiling and wall above them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Casablanca apartment party. GIRL gestures enthusiastically while chatting, ADAM forces a nervous awkward smile, sweating a little, scratching the back of his head. Wide shot from further away: the characters are drawn SMALLER, their heads well below the upper third of the picture (heads around 40% from the top), lots of ceiling and wall above them.
